title: No-route routing cases: no single grader passes on both a missing route file and no-workflow
context: AC-3 asks the slash-command and system-notification cases to pass on a missing .paqad/context/.session-route.json AND on "workflow":"no-workflow", and fail on a real workflow. A real run showed a regex grader on {source: file} THROWS and fails when the file is missing ("path does not exist"), so a not_contains regex cannot pass on a missing file. file_exists exists:false passes on a missing file but fails on a no-workflow file. Graders are scored as a weighted mean, not OR. Code reading (src/pipeline/prompt-lane.ts runPromptRouteSeam) shows the hook returns before writeSessionRoute for both prompt kinds, so today it writes no file at all. AC-4 (any real workflow fails, missing file passes) holds with file_exists.

options.label: Grade both cases with file_exists exists:false on the route file (a no-workflow file would read red, which is stricter than AC-3, matching what the hook does today)
